methodology: Only roles resolved to an official company site or its named applicant-tracking system are published. The deterministic scanner covers accessible Greenhouse and Lever boards; the daily research agent checks Workday, Ashby, custom, and blocked pages separately. 'New' means newly observed by this local tracker, not necessarily newly posted by the employer. Qualifications are aggregated across companies before portfolio advice is promoted.
